title: Fubini swap for the mollified weight against μ: ∫ζ(y)(∫ρ(y − z)dμ(z))dy = ∫(∫ζ(y)ρ(y − z)dy)dμ(z), with integrability
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let μ be any measure on ℝ^N (Borel σ-algebra), let ζ, ρ : ℝ^N → ℝ be continuous with compact support, let r ∈ ℝ with tsupport ρ ⊆ B̄_r(0), and suppose μ(K') < ∞ for K' := cthickening(r, tsupport ζ), the closed r-neighbourhood of tsupport ζ. Then the function y ↦ ζ(y)∫ρ(y − z) dμ(z) is L^N-integrable, and ∫ ζ(y)(∫ ρ(y − z) dμ(z)) dL^N(y) = ∫ (∫ ζ(y)ρ(y − z) dL^N(y)) dμ(z). All integrals are Bochner integrals, so the integral of a non-integrable function is 0. For y ∉ tsupport ζ the factor ζ(y) vanishes, so the integrand ζ(y)∫ρ(y − z)dμ(z) is 0 there whether or not z ↦ ρ(y − z) is μ-integrable.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ζ ρ : Rn N → ℝ) (r : ℝ), Continuous ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → tsupport ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : Rn N) r → μ (Metric.cthickening r (tsupport ζ)) < ∞ → Integrable (fun y ↦ ζ y * (∫ z, ρ (y - z) ∂μ)) ∧ ∫ y, ζ y * (∫ z, ρ (y - z) ∂μ) = ∫ z, (∫ y, ζ y * ρ (y - z)) ∂μ
